overview_description.description:
Campaign Monitor, a CM Group brand, provides an email marketing platform for businesses. Millions of marketing professionals at more than 150,000 companies around the world, including BuzzFeed, BirchBox, Coca-Cola, Disney, Rip Curl, and the San Diego Chargers, use Campaign Monitor to run email marketing campaigns that deliver results for their business. With their email marketing and automation tools, customers can create and deliver eye-catching emails that drive real business results.

Campaign Monitor was established in 2004.

about_short_description.short_description: Campaign Monitor is an email marketing platform that allows marketers to take control of their email program.

product.name: Campaign Monitor Email Marketing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating, sending, automating, personalizing, and analyzing email marketing campaigns and subscriber journeys.

product.name: Campaign Monitor for Agencies
product.description: Agency-oriented email marketing capabilities for managing multiple client accounts, teams, campaigns, permissions, billing, templates, and automations from a centralized environment.

product.name: Campaign Monitor API
product.description: An API for integrating Campaign Monitor with CMSs, blogs, CRMs, e-commerce systems, and other software to manage campaigns, lists, subscribers, journeys, templates, and transactional email.

product.name: Campaign Monitor Website Builder
product.description: A drag-and-drop website creation tool managed within Campaign Monitor for launching websites and connecting them to email subscriber lists and marketing activities.

product.name: Campaign Monitor SMS
product.description: An SMS marketing capability for extending Campaign Monitor campaigns to mobile messaging and coordinating communications across email and text channels.

product.name: Campaign Monitor Professional Services
product.description: Expert services for email marketing setup, training, deliverability support, and strategic guidance to help teams operate Campaign Monitor programs.
